target_refuted: mu*(A+S) <= 2*A and any positive dimension-uniform constant derived from bare Jensen alone
asymptotic_barrier: For every fixed 0<mu<1, the parallel Jensen ratio is asymptotic to 3/[n*mu*(1-mu)] and tends to zero.
scope: This refutes only the bare second-moment Jensen route. It does not refute K(A)>=(mu/2)A^{-1}, which retains inverse-matrix variance.
